````text
```bash
python -m lm_eval \
    --model hf \
    --model_args pretrained=$MODELDIR,trust_remote_code=True \
````

     ```python
     from modelscope import snapshot_download
     import os, time, shutil
     
     DLDIR = '/root/autodl-tmp/pythia_weights_70m'
     ```
